chunks.title: Frequently Asked Questions for Brightwave Digital Clients
chunks.text:
## General Client Questions

### Where is Brightwave Digital located?
Our primary delivery headquarters is located at 6th Floor, Synergy Tower, SG Highway, Bodakdev, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380054, India. We also maintain satellite client consultation desks in Mumbai (BKC) and Bengaluru (Indiranagar).

### How quickly can a new campaign launch after signing?
Standard onboarding requires 10 business days from contract execution and initial payment receipt. During this window, we complete technical audits, configure tracking pixels, establish 1Password guest vaults, and align on initial creative deliverables. Live campaign activation commences on Day 11.

### Who owns the ad accounts and creative assets?
The client retains 100% legal ownership of all advertising accounts (Google Ads, Meta Business Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager), custom creative assets, Figma design files, and Looker Studio dashboards. Brightwave Digital operates strictly with Agency Partner access. If our partnership terminates, you retain uninterrupted access to all accounts and historical performance data.

### What are your standard business and support hours?
Our agency operations operate Monday through Friday from 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST. Dedicated Slack Connect channels are monitored continuously during these hours. Urgent campaign disruptions or production outages outside business hours are handled 24/7 through our automated emergency escalation matrix.

### What is the minimum contract commitment?
Our Silver Growth package requires a minimum 3-month commitment to allow sufficient time for search algorithm indexing and algorithmic ad learning. Our Gold Scale and Platinum Market Leader packages carry a 6-month commitment. After the initial term, retainers transition to convenient month-to-month contracts subject to a 30-day written cancellation notice.

chunks.title: Frequently Asked Questions for Brightwave Digital Clients
chunks.text:
### Does your retainer fee include advertising media spend?
No. All ad spend is paid directly by your company to Google, Meta, or LinkedIn using your corporate credit card or direct credit line. Our retainer fee covers strategic planning, copywriting, design, technical optimization, ongoing management, and reporting.

chunks.title: Standard Operating Procedure for Client Onboarding
chunks.text:
## Purpose and Scope
This Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) governs the formal intake and onboarding sequence for all new retainers and project clients at Brightwave Digital, Ahmedabad. Adherence ensures seamless technical transitions, zero credential loss, and SLA alignment within 10 business days of contract execution.

chunks.title: Standard Operating Procedure for Client Onboarding
chunks.text:
## Phase 1: Handover and Contract Verification (Days 1–2)
1. Upon contract sign-off in DocuSign, the Business Development team transfers account ownership to Neha Parikh (Head of Client Success) via internal Slack channel `#client-handovers`.
2. The assigned Account Manager verifies that the initial retainer deposit (50% upfront for projects or 100% first month for retainers) is credited to Brightwave's HDFC Bank current account.
3. Account Manager initializes the client workspace in ClickUp using the `Standard-Agency-Onboarding-v4` template.

chunks.title: Standard Operating Procedure for Client Onboarding
chunks.text:
## Phase 2: Kickoff Meeting and Asset Collection (Days 3–5)
1. The Account Manager schedules a 60-minute virtual or in-person kickoff meeting at our Ahmedabad headquarters on SG Highway.
2. The client is provided access to a 1Password guest vault containing invitations to share Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, Google Ads Manager, and Meta Business Suite credentials. Under no circumstances should passwords be transmitted via plain email or WhatsApp.
3. The Strategy Lead completes the Brand Questionnaire covering brand guidelines, tone of voice, top three direct competitors, and target demographics across Tier 1 and Tier 2 Indian cities.

chunks.title: Standard Operating Procedure for Client Onboarding
chunks.text:
## Phase 3: Technical Audit and Roadmap Sign-off (Days 6–10)
1. Technical and SEO specialists conduct a baseline audit within 72 hours of receiving asset access.
2. The Account Manager delivers the 90-Day Performance Roadmap outlining milestones, KPIs, weekly sync slots (Tuesdays or Thursdays between 2:00 PM and 4:00 PM IST), and reporting cadence.
3. Onboarding formally concludes when the client approves the initial sprint backlog in ClickUp and signs the Onboarding Acceptance Certificate.

chunks.title: Content Marketing and Editorial Strategy Services
chunks.text:
## Service Overview
Brightwave Digital creates search-optimized, reader-focused content that builds brand authority, educates buyers, and converts visitors into qualified inbound leads. Divya Rathod heads our Editorial and Content Marketing team in Ahmedabad, working across B2B SaaS, healthcare, real estate, manufacturing, and consumer technology verticals.

chunks.title: Content Marketing and Editorial Strategy Services
chunks.text:
## What We Deliver

### 1. Editorial Strategy & Content Planning
- Comprehensive content gap audits analyzing competitor rankings and unmet search intents.
- Quarterly editorial calendars aligned with seasonal purchasing cycles, product launches, and industry conferences.
- Brand tone-of-voice frameworks and editorial style guides ensuring consistent voice across all digital customer touchpoints.

### 2. Long-Form Authority Articles & Blog Posts
- In-depth, research-backed articles (1,500 to 3,000 words) written by specialized domain copywriters.
- Original expert interviews, proprietary data analysis, and bespoke infographics.
- Complete on-page optimization including schema markup, meta descriptions, alt tags, and contextual call-to-actions.

### 3. Lead Magnets & Whitepapers
- Comprehensive industry research reports, executive playbooks, comparison whitepapers, and downloadable Excel/PDF templates designed to drive high-converting lead generation campaigns.
- Gated landing page copy designed with conversion rate optimization (CRO) principles.

### 4. Email Newsletter Editorial
- Weekly and bi-weekly curated email newsletters designed for customer retention, pipeline nurturing, and product adoption.
- Automation drip sequences for welcome workflows, re-engagement campaigns, and product trial onboarding.

chunks.title: Content Marketing and Editorial Strategy Services
chunks.text:
## Production Standards & Quality Assurance
Every asset delivered by Brightwave Digital undergoes a triple-gate review:
1. Editorial Proofreading (Grammarly Business score 95+, zero factual inaccuracies).
2. Originality Check (100% human-verified original writing, Copyscape passed with 0% duplication).
3. Search Intent Review (SurferSEO or Clearscope content optimization score 80+).

chunks.title: Commercial Pricing Discretion, Discount Bands, and Margin Policy
chunks.text:
## Confidentiality & Commercial Purpose
This policy document establishes mandatory commercial thresholds, gross margin guardrails, and hierarchical discount approval limits for all client contracts generated by Brightwave Digital. This document is strictly restricted to Finance and Executive Management.

chunks.title: Commercial Pricing Discretion, Discount Bands, and Margin Policy
chunks.text:
## Absolute Margin Guardrails
1. **Target Gross Margin**: All standard proposals and retainer pricing models are engineered to achieve a target gross margin of 55%.
2. **Hard Minimum Gross Margin**: Under no operational or competitive circumstance may any client engagement be signed with a projected gross margin below 42%. Proposals failing this floor are automatically vetoed by Finance.
3. **Minimum Contract Value Floor**: Even with approved discounts, no monthly retainer may be booked below the baseline floor of ₹60,000 per month (+ GST).

chunks.title: Commercial Pricing Discretion, Discount Bands, and Margin Policy
chunks.text:
## Hierarchical Discount Authority Limits
Discounts on Brightwave Digital’s standard retainer rates (Silver ₹75,000, Gold ₹1,50,000, Platinum ₹2,75,000) are governed strictly by the following approval thresholds:

- **Tier 1 Discount (0.0% to 5.0%)**:
  - *Authority*: Account Directors or VP of Client Success.
  - *Condition*: Applicable solely for clients committing to a 12-month non-cancellable contract with full 100% upfront annual payment.
- **Tier 2 Discount (5.1% to 10.0%)**:
  - *Authority*: Manish Gokhale, Head of Finance.
  - *Condition*: Requires written financial justification submitted via Jira Finance ticket, verifying client credit rating and minimum estimated spend volume.
- **Tier 3 Discount (10.1% to 15.0%)**:
  - *Authority*: Unanimous joint written sign-off from both Manish Gokhale (Head of Finance) and Vikram Joshi (Managing Partner).
  - *Condition*: Reserved exclusively for multi-year enterprise accounts or strategic logo acquisition.
- **Hard Maximum Ceiling**:
  - **The absolute maximum discount percentage permitted across Brightwave Digital is 15.0%**. No employee, director, or partner possesses authority to quote or contract discounts exceeding 15%.

chunks.title: Commercial Pricing Discretion, Discount Bands, and Margin Policy
chunks.text:
## Ad Spend Commission Discretion
For ad spend exceeding ₹15,00,000 per month, standard management fees transition from fixed retainer to 8% of gross ad spend. Finance may negotiate this down to 6.5% for media budgets exceeding ₹50,00,000 monthly, provided the 42% minimum margin test is satisfied.

chunks.title: Production Incident and Account Crisis Escalation Matrix
chunks.text:
## Scope and Intent
This matrix dictates the immediate response protocol for critical account emergencies, technical website downtime, catastrophic ad-spend overruns, social PR crises, or data leakage at Brightwave Digital. Ananya Iyer (VP of Operations) acts as incident Commander.

chunks.title: Production Incident and Account Crisis Escalation Matrix
chunks.text:
## Severity Level Classifications

### Severity 1 (Critical / Blocker)
- **Criteria**: Client website or landing page completely offline during active ad campaigns; ad spend overrun exceeding ₹50,000 above daily cap; unintended post published triggering legal threat or PR backlash; tracking tag outage preventing all lead capture.
- **Initial Response Time**: Within 15 minutes of detection, 24/7/365.
- **Action Procedure**:
  1. Incident discoverer calls Ananya Iyer (+91 98250 XXXXX) and pages the `#ops-critical` Slack channel.
  2. For ad overrun, pause all active campaigns in Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager immediately.
  3. Form a virtual war room with Technical Lead, Account Manager, and Managing Partner.
  4. Provide hourly progress updates to client leadership via phone and email.

### Severity 2 (High Priority)
- **Criteria**: Ad account payment failure causing temporary campaign suspension; broken checkout flow on specific product page; discrepancy in Looker Studio data greater than 20%; delayed weekly report exceeding 24 hours without prior notice.
- **Initial Response Time**: Within 1 hour during business hours (9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST), within 3 hours during weekends.
- **Action Procedure**: Account Manager directly coordinates with Media Buyer or Web Analytics specialist to resolve within 4 business hours.

### Severity 3 (Medium / Low Priority)
- **Criteria**: Minor typo in live blog post or social caption; non-critical broken hyperlink; cosmetic layout misalignment on mobile viewport.
- **Initial Response Time**: Within 4 business hours. Resolved within 1 business day.

## Post-Mortem Requirement
For every Severity 1 and Severity 2 incident, an Incident Retrospective document must be published within 48 hours of resolution, specifying root cause, financial impact in INR, remediation steps taken, and preventative safeguards.

chunks.title: Internal HR Guidelines, Leave Policies, and Employee FAQ
chunks.text:
## Employee Welfare and Attendance Standards
This document provides key answers regarding human resources policies, leave entitlement, remote work regulations, and health benefits at Brightwave Digital. Rashmi Patel leads People Operations.

chunks.title: Internal HR Guidelines, Leave Policies, and Employee FAQ
chunks.text:
## Leave Entitlement and Quotas
Brightwave Digital provides 24 days of paid time off per calendar year (January 1 to December 31) for confirmed full-time team members, credited on a pro-rata basis:
- **Privilege Leaves (PL)**: 12 days per annum. Up to 6 unused PL days can be carried forward to the following calendar year, with a lifetime accumulation cap of 30 days. Must be applied at least 7 days in advance via Darwinbox.
- **Casual Leaves (CL)**: 8 days per annum. Designed for personal exigencies. Cannot be clubbed with more than 2 consecutive days.
- **Sick Leaves (SL)**: 4 days per annum. Absences exceeding 2 consecutive days require a signed medical certificate from a registered practitioner.
- **Maternity & Paternity Benefits**: 26 weeks paid maternity leave in accordance with statutory norms; 2 weeks (10 business days) paid paternity leave.

chunks.title: Internal HR Guidelines, Leave Policies, and Employee FAQ
chunks.text:
## Hybrid Work and Office Hours
1. **Hybrid Schedule**: Brightwave operates on a 3:2 hybrid schedule. Employees work from the Ahmedabad headquarters on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays. Tuesdays and Thursdays are designated flexible remote work days.
2. **Core Hours**: All employees are expected to be available online on Slack and for internal meetings between 10:00 AM and 5:00 PM IST. Standard agency shift spans 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM IST.

chunks.title: Internal HR Guidelines, Leave Policies, and Employee FAQ
chunks.text:
## Healthcare & Wellness Coverage
- Every full-time employee and their immediate dependents (spouse and up to two children) are enrolled in a ₹5,00,000 cashless group health insurance policy underwritten by Star Health Insurance.
- Annual health wellness checkups are hosted every November at our Ahmedabad office campus in partnership with Apollo Hospitals.

chunks.title: Internal HR Guidelines, Leave Policies, and Employee FAQ
chunks.text:
## Notice Periods and Separation
- Confirmed full-time employees have a formal notice period of 60 calendar days.
- Team members on initial 3-month probation have a 30-day notice period.
- Buyout of notice period requires explicit joint approval from Rashmi Patel and Managing Partner Vikram Joshi.

chunks.title: Paid Media and Performance Advertising Services
chunks.text:
## Service Overview

We manage multi-channel paid ad campaigns across Google Ads, Meta (Instagram & Facebook), LinkedIn Ads, and YouTube.

chunks.title: Paid Media and Performance Advertising Services
chunks.text:
## Platform Capabilities & Specializations

### 1. Google Ads (Search, Performance Max, Display, YouTube)

- **Performance Max (PMax) Campaigns**: Custom audience signal feeds, asset group segmentation, and negative brand list exclusions.
- **YouTube In-Stream & Shorts Ads**: Video action campaigns targeting high-intent in-market buyer segments.

### 2. Meta Ads (Instagram & Facebook Ads)
- Dynamic Creative Testing (DCT) testing multiple hooks, creative angles, and call-to-actions.
- Conversion API (CAPI) server-side tracking integrations preventing signal loss from browser cookie restrictions.
- Custom audience lookalikes derived from offline CRM data and high-value customer purchase cohorts.

### 3. LinkedIn Ads for B2B Demand Generation
- Matched audiences targeting decision-makers (Director, VP, CXO) across Indian IT corridors and global enterprises.
- Thought Leader Ads utilizing personal executive profiles for superior trust and CTR.
- Conversational Lead Gen Forms delivering average 18% conversion rates compared to standard web landing pages.

chunks.title: Paid Media and Performance Advertising Services
chunks.text:

chunks.title: Digital Marketing Retainer Packages and Public Pricing Guide
chunks.text:
## Overview of Brightwave Retainer Tiers
Brightwave Digital offers three standardized monthly retainer packages tailored to growing startups, mid-market enterprises, and national brands. All pricing is stated in Indian Rupees (INR) exclusive of applicable 18% Goods and Services Tax (GST). Managed media spend is paid directly by clients to advertising platforms and is separate from agency service retainers.

chunks.title: Digital Marketing Retainer Packages and Public Pricing Guide
chunks.text:
## Retainer Tiers & Inclusions

### 1. Silver Growth Retainer (₹75,000 / month + GST)
- **Target Audience**: Early-stage companies and specialized local businesses establishing predictable digital acquisition.
- **Included Scope**:
  - Full Technical SEO baseline audit plus on-page optimization for up to 15 core landing pages.
  - 4 high-authority, search-optimized blog posts per month (1,200 words each).
  - Single-channel Paid Media management (Google Ads or Meta Ads) managing up to ₹2,50,000 in monthly ad spend.
  - Monthly automated Looker Studio executive dashboard.
  - Bi-weekly 30-minute progress calls with an Account Executive.
- **Contract Term**: Minimum 3-month initial commitment, transitioning to 30-day rolling cancellation.

### 2. Gold Scale Retainer (₹1,50,000 / month + GST)
- **Target Audience**: Established mid-market companies scaling customer acquisition across multiple channels.
- **Included Scope**:
  - Comprehensive SEO architecture covering up to 40 landing pages plus continuous competitor keyword monitoring.
  - 8 long-form content assets per month (1,500 words each) and active digital PR link outreach (5 backlinks/month).
  - Multi-channel Paid Media management (Google Ads + Meta Ads + LinkedIn Ads) managing up to ₹7,50,000 monthly ad spend.
  - Social media creative calendar: 12 designed posts/reels per month with community moderation.
  - Weekly flash reporting email plus dedicated monthly review call.
  - Dedicated Account Manager with guaranteed 4-hour business day communication turnaround.
- **Contract Term**: Minimum 6-month initial engagement.

chunks.title: Digital Marketing Retainer Packages and Public Pricing Guide
chunks.text:
### 3. Platinum Market Leader Retainer (₹2,75,000 / month + GST)
- **Target Audience**: High-growth category leaders, D2C conglomerates, and global B2B enterprises requiring full-funnel digital dominance.
- **Included Scope**:
  - Uncapped search optimization covering unlimited landing pages, international SEO, and ongoing technical maintenance.
  - 16 authority articles per month, 2 quarterly whitepapers/case studies, and executive thought leadership ghostwriting.
  - Multi-channel performance marketing with uncapped monthly media spend across Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and YouTube.
  - Creative suite: 20 bespoke static graphics, 8 edited short-form video reels, and conversion copy testing.
  - Server-Side GTM, GA4 BigQuery export, and conversion rate optimization (CRO) testing.
  - Direct Slack Connect channel, priority 1-hour SLA, and monthly executive consultation with Managing Partner Vikram Joshi.
- **Contract Term**: Minimum 6-month initial engagement.

chunks.title: Project Aurora Corporate Website Redesign Scope and Architecture
chunks.text:
## Executive Summary
Project Aurora is Brightwave Digital’s comprehensive internal digital transformation and flagship website redesign. Tarun Shah (Lead Full-Stack Architect) oversees engineering, collaborating with Creative Lead Pooja Shah and Strategy Lead Rohan Mehta.

chunks.title: Project Aurora Corporate Website Redesign Scope and Architecture
chunks.text:
## Strategic Objectives and Target Outcomes
The legacy WordPress agency portal is being phased out due to performance bottlenecks and security vulnerabilities. Project Aurora aims to establish Brightwave as India's premier high-tech digital agency:
1. Elevate organic search discovery by targeting competitive enterprise SEO keywords across Mumbai, Delhi NCR, and Bengaluru.
2. Achieve 100/100 Core Web Vitals across mobile and desktop devices.
3. Boost inbound lead conversion rate from 1.8% to 4.5% via dynamic interactive calculators.
4. Target production deployment date is November 15, 2026, with staging validation commencing October 20.

chunks.title: Project Aurora Corporate Website Redesign Scope and Architecture
chunks.text:
## Technical Architecture & Approved Stack
- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router with React Server Components) deployed on Vercel Enterprise.
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS utilizing Brightwave's proprietary design token library (primary accent `#2F6F6B`).
- **Headless CMS**: Sanity.io for structured editorial content, author profiles, and case study taxonomies.
- **Analytics & Tracking**: Server-side Google Tag Manager with BigQuery data stream and Microsoft Clarity heatmaps.
- **Integrations**: HubSpot CRM form webhooks, Cal.com scheduling embeds, and WhatsApp Business API gateway.

chunks.title: Project Aurora Corporate Website Redesign Scope and Architecture
chunks.text:
## Resource Allocation and Budget
- **Total Approved Capital Expenditure (CapEx)**: ₹18,50,000 inclusive of external 3D motion design licenses and specialized security penetration testing.
- **Dedicated Sprint Team**:
  - 1 Lead Architect (Tarun Shah)
  - 2 Senior Frontend Engineers (Aarav Dave, Kavita Vora)
  - 1 UI/UX Specialist (Pooja Shah)
  - 1 QA Lead (Mitesh Rana)
- Weekly sprint demos take place every Friday at 4:30 PM IST in the Ahmedabad Innovation Lab.

chunks.title: Client Reporting Schedule and Delivery Standards
chunks.text:
## Overview
Brightwave Digital maintains rigorous reporting governance to ensure transparent ROI demonstration across all digital marketing campaigns. Rohan Mehta oversees cross-team reporting compliance. Reports are categorized into Weekly Flash Updates, Monthly Executive Reviews, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).

chunks.title: Client Reporting Schedule and Delivery Standards
chunks.text:
## Weekly Flash Updates
- **Audience & Delivery**: Direct client POC via automated email digest and Slack Connect channel.
- **Delivery Timeline**: Every Monday by 11:30 AM IST.
- **Key Metrics Included**: 7-day spend in INR, total conversions/leads generated, average Cost Per Lead (CPL) or Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) for eCommerce accounts, and active sprint deliverables.
- **Responsible Party**: Assigned Account Executive drafts data from Looker Studio; Account Manager reviews and sends.

chunks.title: Client Reporting Schedule and Delivery Standards
chunks.text:
## Monthly Executive Performance Reports
- **Audience & Delivery**: C-Suite, VP Marketing, and agency stakeholders via interactive Looker Studio dashboards accompanied by a comprehensive 12-page PDF slide deck.
- **Delivery Timeline**: Generated on the 3rd business day of each month and dispatched by the 5th business day by 5:00 PM IST.
- **Key Components**: Organic traffic trends, keyword rankings (top 3, top 10 positions), paid media blended efficiency, social media engagement rates, completed deliverables, budget reconciliation, and month-ahead optimization focus.
- **Review Meeting**: A mandatory 45-minute review call is hosted between the 6th and 10th of every month.

chunks.title: Client Reporting Schedule and Delivery Standards
chunks.text:
## Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR)
- **Schedule**: First two weeks following the close of Q1, Q2, Q3, and Q4 (fiscal year ending March 31).
- **Structure**: Comprehensive multi-channel attribution analysis, competitive market share benchmarks, industry trend forecasting, and contract renewal or expansion recommendations.
- **Sign-off Requirement**: Every QBR presentation must be co-reviewed by Managing Partner Vikram Joshi 48 hours prior to the client presentation.

chunks.title: Retainer Billing Schedules, Invoicing Protocols, and Collection Terms
chunks.text:
## Scope and Financial Governance
This document specifies the billing cycles, tax documentation protocols, credit periods, late penalty structures, and default enforcement procedures enforced by the Brightwave Digital Finance Department under Manish Gokhale.

chunks.title: Retainer Billing Schedules, Invoicing Protocols, and Collection Terms
chunks.text:
## Recurring Billing Cycle & Invoicing Dates
1. **Advance Billing Schedule**: All monthly retainer agreements are billed in advance. Invoices are automatically generated in Zoho Books on the 25th day of every calendar month for the subsequent service month (e.g., invoices generated on October 25th cover November 1–30 service).
2. **Project Milestones**: Fixed-scope development or audit projects are invoiced on a 50-30-20 milestone structure (50% mobilization advance upon signing, 30% upon staging delivery, 20% upon final production sign-off).
3. **Goods and Services Tax (GST)**: All tax invoices include 18% GST (9% CGST + 9% SGST for clients within Gujarat, or 18% IGST for interstate clients). HSN/SAC Code for digital marketing services is 998311.

chunks.title: Retainer Billing Schedules, Invoicing Protocols, and Collection Terms
chunks.text:
## Credit Terms and Payment Due Dates
- **Standard Payment Terms**: Net 15 days from the date of invoice issuance. Consequently, monthly retainer payments are due on the 10th day of the service month.
- **Accepted Modes**: RTGS, NEFT, or IMPS into Brightwave Digital’s corporate bank account at HDFC Bank (Navrangpura Branch, Ahmedabad; IFSC: HDFC0000006). International remittances must arrive via wire in USD or EUR to our designated EEFC account.
- **Tax Deducted at Source (TDS)**: Clients deducting TDS under Section 194C (2% for advertising contracts) or Section 194J (10% for professional technical services) must upload formal Form 16A quarterly TDS certificates to the finance portal within 45 days of quarter end.

chunks.title: Retainer Billing Schedules, Invoicing Protocols, and Collection Terms
chunks.text:
## Penalties and Service Suspension Protocols
1. **Late Payment Fee**: Accounts outstanding beyond Net 15 days incur a mandatory late payment penalty calculated at 1.5% per month (18% annualized) compounded monthly on the total unpaid overdue balance.
2. **Grace Period & Reminder Protocol**: Polite automated reminders are dispatched on Day +5 and Day +10 past due.
3. **Work Suspension Trigger**: If any invoice remains unpaid after 30 calendar days from issuance, the Finance Lead enforces automatic project freeze: all live ad campaigns across Google and Meta are paused, deliverables are halted, and client portal access is revoked until full account clearance.

chunks.title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Services Overview
chunks.text:
## Service Overview
Brightwave Digital delivers enterprise-grade Search Engine Optimization (SEO) engineered to build sustainable, high-intent organic traffic for B2B enterprises, D2C brands, and multi-location businesses across India and international markets. Kunal Trivedi leads our SEO Practice Group from our Ahmedabad studio.

chunks.title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Services Overview
chunks.text:
## Core Pillars of our SEO Delivery

### 1. Technical SEO & Core Web Vitals Optimization
We conduct forensic audits inspecting indexability, crawl budget allocation, XML sitemaps, robots.txt directives, canonicalization, JavaScript rendering issues, and structured schema markup (JSON-LD for Organization, Product, FAQPage, and LocalBusiness). We optimize site architecture to achieve 90+ mobile Google PageSpeed scores, resolving Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) under 2.5s, Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) under 0.1, and Interaction to Next Paint (INP) under 200ms.

### 2. On-Page & Semantic Content Architecture
Our team maps target keyword clusters using Semrush, Ahrefs, and Google Keyword Planner. We construct semantic topical authority clusters around commercial and informational search intents. Every landing page receives customized metadata, semantic H1–H4 header hierarchy, keyword-balanced internal linking, and conversion-focused copy.

### 3. High-Authority Link Building & Digital PR
Brightwave adheres strictly to white-hat link acquisition standards. We execute proactive digital PR outreach, guest thought leadership contributions on authoritative industry publications (Domain Rating 50+), broken backlink reclamation, and regional brand citations across verified Indian business directories.

### 4. Local SEO for Multi-Location Businesses
For multi-city brands, we optimize Google Business Profiles (GBP), harmonize Name-Address-Phone (NAP) consistency across 50+ aggregators, implement localized geo-targeted schema, and configure review collection funnels.

chunks.title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Services Overview
chunks.text:
## Typical Deliverables & Timeline
- Month 1: 40-point Technical SEO Audit, keyword research matrix, initial quick-win on-page fixes.
- Month 2: Content cluster creation, internal linking graph re-engineering, initial 5 link placements.
- Month 3 onwards: Bi-weekly technical crawls, recurring high-intent blog publications, monthly ranking tracking across desktop and mobile SERPs.

chunks.title: Social Media Content Approval and Publishing Workflow
chunks.text:
## Objective
This SOP standardizes social media content creation, internal peer review, client sign-off, and scheduling across Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, and X for all agency accounts managed by Brightwave Digital. Pooja Shah (Creative Operations Director) serves as primary process owner.

chunks.title: Social Media Content Approval and Publishing Workflow
chunks.text:
## Step 1: Monthly Content Calendar Drafting (Days 15–20 of Month T-1)
1. The Content Strategist reviews client theme briefs, upcoming product launches, Indian festive dates (e.g., Diwali, Uttarayan, Navratri), and trending audio/topics.
2. An editorial grid of 12 to 20 post concepts is prepared in Planoly / Notion, specifying visual asset type (static carousel, motion graphic, 9:16 reel), copy in English or Gujarati, hashtags, and CTA.
3. Graphic designers complete draft creative assets in Figma by the 20th of the month.

chunks.title: Social Media Content Approval and Publishing Workflow
chunks.text:
## Step 2: Internal Quality Gate (Days 21–23)
1. Copy is proofread by the Senior Content Editor for factual accuracy, spelling, and tone alignment.
2. Pooja Shah inspects visual assets against client brand guidelines (pantone color codes, font usage, logo safe zones).
3. Any revisions must be returned to the design team with 24 hours turnaround.

chunks.title: Social Media Content Approval and Publishing Workflow
chunks.text:
## Step 3: Client Review and Sign-Off (Days 24–28)
1. The calendar is submitted through the Brightwave Client Review Portal or Notion board by 5:00 PM IST on the 24th.
2. Clients are asked to review, leave comments, and approve items within 3 business days.
3. If no client response is received after 48 hours, the Account Manager triggers a reminder call.

chunks.title: Social Media Content Approval and Publishing Workflow
chunks.text:
## Step 4: Scheduling and Real-time Engagement
1. All approved posts are scheduled in Sprout Social by 6:00 PM IST on the final business day of the month.
2. For real-time topical posts or moment marketing, an expedited 4-hour approval protocol is followed: draft shared via emergency Slack ping to client POC, requiring one explicit written confirmation before posting.

chunks.title: Brightwave 2027 Strategic Roadmap, Expansion, and Financial Projections

## Strict Confidentiality Notice

Access is strictly limited to Managing Partners and Board Directors. Unauthorized sharing constitutes a material breach of fiduciary duty.

chunks.title: Brightwave 2027 Strategic Roadmap, Expansion, and Financial Projections

## Three-Year Revenue Targets and Financial Milestones
Managing Partner Vikram Joshi, in consultation with Finance Head Manish Gokhale, has formalized the three-year financial trajectory:
1. **FY2026 Performance Baseline**: Closing at ₹26.00 Crore in annual recurring agency revenue with 24% net operating profit margin.
2. **FY2027 Revenue Target**: Brightwave has established a formal revenue target of ₹48,00,00,000 (₹48.00 Crore ARR) for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. This represents an 84.6% top-line growth trajectory driven by enterprise retainers.
3. **FY2028 Aspirational Benchmark**: Reaching ₹75.00 Crore ARR and exploring a domestic IPO or pre-IPO institutional round on the NSE Emerge platform.

chunks.text:
## Planned Talent Headcount Expansion
To sustain this growth velocity, headcount will scale systematically across our Ahmedabad engineering base and regional offices:
- Current full-time employee count stands at 45 team members as of September 2026.
- The company will expand headcount to 95 full-time employees by December 2027.
- Priority talent acquisitions include:
  - 12 Senior Performance Media Buyers
  - 8 AI/ML Engineers specializing in marketing automation
  - 15 Senior Content Strategists and Creative Directors
  - 2 Regional Sales Vice Presidents stationed in Dubai and Singapore.

## Strategic M&A (Mergers and Acquisitions) Roadmap
Brightwave has earmarked a capital war chest of ₹10,00,00,000 (₹10.00 Crore) for strategic acquisitions over the next 18 months:
1. **Project Nectar (Pune)**: Target acquisition of a boutique Generative AI and synthetic video studio in Pune with an approved deal valuation cap of ₹4,50,00,000 (₹4.50 Crore). Target closing date: Q1 2027.
2. **Project Falcon (Bengaluru)**: Acquisition of a high-growth Amazon and quick-commerce performance agency in Indiranagar, Bengaluru, budgeted at ₹3,50,00,000 (₹3.50 Crore), planned for Q3 2027.

- Brightwave will inaugurate its first international liaison office in Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), United Arab Emirates, by May 2027 (Q2 2027). This hub will target luxury real estate and regional fintech retainers across the GCC.

chunks.title: Web Analytics Implementation and Tracking Infrastructure
chunks.text:
## Service Overview
Brightwave Digital’s Web Analytics and Measurement practice, overseen by Principal Data Architect Sameer Patel, ensures complete, reliable, and privacy-compliant data capture for marketing decision-makers. Clean data forms the foundation of all profitable marketing optimization.

chunks.title: Web Analytics Implementation and Tracking Infrastructure
chunks.text:
## Measurement Solutions

### 1. Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Architecture
- Enterprise GA4 property hierarchy configuration, data stream provisioning, and cross-domain tracking setup.
- Custom event taxonomy design mapping custom dimensions, metrics, and user properties.
- Enhanced measurement customization, engagement time tracking, and scroll-depth milestone captures.
- Google BigQuery export integration for historical raw event storage and advanced SQL cohort analysis.

### 2. Google Tag Manager (GTM) Deployment
- Client-side and Server-Side GTM container architecture hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Stape.
- Conversion tracking implementation across Google Ads, Meta Pixel, LinkedIn Insight Tag, Microsoft Advertising, and Twitter/X pixel.
- Consent Management Platform (CMP) integration (Cookiebot, OneTrust) respecting user privacy preferences under GDPR and Indian Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act guidelines.

### 3. Server-Side Tracking & Meta Conversions API (CAPI)
- Server-to-server data transmission mitigating client-side ad blockers, iOS Safari Intelligent Tracking Prevention (ITP), and network latency.
- Event Quality Match Score optimization targeting 8.5/10 or higher on Meta Business Manager via hashed user parameters (email, phone, city, IP, user-agent).

### 4. Interactive BI Dashboards
- Automated executive reporting dashboards built in Looker Studio, PowerBI, or Tableau.
- Blended data models combining ad spend, web session journeys, CRM lead statuses (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho), and Shopify revenue streams.
- Real-time anomaly alerts notifying team members on Slack when tracking drops below baseline thresholds.
